rounds.title: Audit and pre-seed
rounds.detail: Seven parallel auditors read the 87-file, 63,846-line Swift source and returned file:line-verified findings; a synthesizer deduplicated them into 30 tasks across six workstreams with disjoint file ownership. The integrator then seeded the two compile-time contentions that the hand-off protocol cannot cover — DS.Number.display plus the dialog/detached-pane size bands and pane symbols in the frozen DesignSystem.swift, and the inert sticky-pan / pending-link API in NetworkEditorModel.swift — and verified build and lint still pass.

rounds.title: Build, integrate, critique
rounds.detail: Six implementers landed the first pass: sticky double-click pan, drag-to-connect, the archetype library and gallery, pane maximize, the DSPanelWindow host, ⌘F/⌘C shell routing, and the universal decimal filter at the terminal boundary. Critics returned five needs_work verdicts. Ended with 16 blocking findings and 44 improvements.

rounds.title: Build, integrate, critique
rounds.detail: Pane detachment into real windows, frame persistence across every window, wide-table measurement, and the second pass on the precision filter. Critics began driving the built app rather than reading code. Ended with 20 blocking findings and 35 improvements.

rounds.title: Build, integrate, critique
rounds.detail: Hardening and polish; showAlert calls in the hot file fell from 87 to 4. Critics reproduced defects clean-room with real CGEvent clicks and AXPress on menu items — which is how the undo regression was found. Ended with 26 blocking findings and 37 improvements.

rounds.title: Blocker close-out
rounds.detail: The 26 findings deduplicated to 14 distinct issues and routed correctly for the first time. An orchestration bug had been matching critic labels like "W2 (NetworkEditorModel.swift) with W6" against a bare "W2", so in round 3 none of the 26 reached an implementer. Undo was fixed at the root: selectedTool became private(set) with setTool as the single writer, so the compiler now prevents the sticky-pan leak from recurring.

rounds.title: Re-verification in a running app
rounds.detail: Verifiers reproduced each original defect report against the built binary — real CGEvent clicks, System Events AX reads, screenshots — rather than reading diffs. 12 of 13 issues closed. The numeric verifier compared three formatters across 20,157 values and caught the live perl filter mid-run to cmp it against the source extraction.

rounds.title: Final close-out and release
rounds.detail: Stop no longer reports a cancelled run as a solver failure — the verdict now keys off the model's own cancel record instead of an exit-code whitelist, so it is immune to which signal wins the SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGKILL race; a genuine failure still reports as one, verified in both directions against a stubbed failing solver. The precision filter gained a conjunctive rule that leaves lone numbers in prose unpadded without shearing a real fixed-width table. Then: the gates were made hermetic (the module cache no longer lives inside the Dropbox-synced tree, which had been producing intermittent swift-frontend crashes that looked like code defects), the release was rebuilt and fully verified, and FILES.sha256 was regenerated.
